submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on short (1-3 character) tokens that cannot stand alone as content words: subword fragments, especially vowel-initial or k/h-onset open syllables (ke, Ka, e/E, o, ha, au, os, al, es), that compose longer words across languages (keer, een, Eesteren, ke- -an nouns, Kasifleri, e-Cigarettes, AS IS), plus short grammatical particles (has, are, de) when licensed by collocational left context (it-has, You-are, van-de/een). It stays silent on self-contained content words even with identical letter sequences (kept, keep, keen, basic, mask) and on ultra-frequent standalone function forms (a, as, is, be, an).
